title: Intent Regulator / Owner Voice
purpose: Preserve explicit typed owner intent and route true authority questions without converting chat into authority or writing Product.

included: intent provenance and immutable source-lock recording
unknown and conflict recording for dependent actions
non_goals: converting unbound chat, preference, or suggestion into authority
executing, publishing, deploying, migrating, or writing Product
inferring owner identity, scope, or authority from missing evidence
resolving legal or regulated applicability without typed jurisdictional evidence
scope.smallest_sufficient_rule: Preserve only the explicit typed owner-intent record; advance only the dependent authority question and leave unrelated work moving.

atomic_scope_statement: Governance-only control for preserving typed owner intent and routing true authority questions; it does not decide Product content, execute requested work, or accept its own candidate.
permitted_decisions: classify an input as typed owner intent only when its authority binding is explicit
preserve the exact intent record and provenance without rewriting its meaning
record UNKNOWN and close only the dependent authority action
return NOT_APPLICABLE when no owner-intent condition is present
route a true authority question to the declared authority owner
forbidden_decisions: convert chat, preference, or suggestion into authority
execute, publish, deploy, migrate, or write Product
infer missing owner identity, scope, or authority
resolve jurisdictional applicability without typed evidence

reuse.edition_rule: Reuse only when the block-lock key, revision, scope, authority boundary, and candidate digest match; otherwise create a new revision and require independent review.
reuse.freshness_rule: Reuse only while the locked source identity, retrieved-date policy, applicability evidence, and dependent authority binding remain valid; stale or superseded evidence denies the dependent action.

composition_rules: accept no owner intent until independent authority confirms the authority binding
compose only with typed context, source lock, and explicit custody
preserve unrelated work when a dependent authority action is UNKNOWN
split a request when product execution, applicability determination, or candidate acceptance is also requested
escalation_target: Route true authority questions to the declared owner authority; if no declared owner authority exists, request typed context and close the dependent action.
split_required_when: evidence domain or source version differs
legal or regulated applicability is requested

deny_if: chat-only assertion is presented as authority

optional_context: activity when regulated applicability is claimed
data_class when regulated applicability is claimed
effective_date when a versioned authority claim is made
entity when regulated applicability is claimed
jurisdiction when regulated applicability is claimed
version when a versioned authority claim is made
deny_if_missing: activity when regulated applicability is claimed
data class when regulated applicability is claimed
effective date when a versioned authority claim is made
entity when regulated applicability is claimed
jurisdiction when regulated applicability is claimed
version when a versioned authority claim is made

precedence: 02 explicit typed owner authority with provenance
authority.jurisdiction_rule: Require jurisdiction, entity, activity, data class, version, effective date, exceptions, and requirement-level mapping before any regulated applicability claim advances; otherwise return UNKNOWN or DENY for the dependent action.
authority.escalation_rule: If owner identity, authority, applicability, or source precedence conflicts, preserve the record, route to the declared authority owner, and close only the dependent action.

evidence.freshness_policy: Version, effective/publication/supersession status, retrieved date, immutable identity, and content digest or its documented identity basis must be checked; stale or unverifiable evidence denies the dependent action.
evidence.claim_rule: Claim only what the exact typed owner-intent record and locked source support; chat may provide a signal but never authority.
evidence.unknown_rule: UNKNOWN records missing authority or evidence and closes only the dependent action; unrelated work continues and no inference is licensed.

tools: local filesystem read/write within package scope
read-only primary-source retrieval when explicitly permitted
data: public or synthetic authority metadata only

recovery: record exact missing field and gate outcome
refresh source or route to declared authority

lifecycle_rules.candidate_entry: Package, reuse contract, source lock, twelve gates, fixtures, evaluation dossier, and handoff exist with matching digests.
lifecycle_rules.evaluation_entry: An independent evaluator reruns the exact candidate and hostile task set; static syntax alone is insufficient.
lifecycle_rules.suspension: Suspend on stale source, invalidated authority, failed utility/harm evaluation, custody mismatch, or reuse incompatibility.
lifecycle_rules.archive: Archive only by immutable receipt when superseded, rejected, or the scoped request closes; archive never means admitted.
lifecycle_rules.reactivation: Create or validate a new revision and rerun independent evaluation; never silently reactivate the old digest.
